title: Gold Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document covers the Gold Plus Account’s mobile banking limits and procedures: mobile check deposits are limited to $25,000 per day, and mobile transfers out are limited to $50,000 per day with instant transfers between eligible accounts. It also explains how to submit deposits (image quality, proper endorsement, keep the check until posted) and gives tips to schedule near-limit transactions and verify recipient details.
